response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(mean_usage) AS overall_mean FROM station_usage) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage_pct, AVG(s.mean_usage - b.overall_mean) AS mean_above_average_percentage_points FROM station_usage AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.mean_usage > b.overall_mean;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average gives each station with a reported usage value equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Use the average across all telescopes with reported usage as the benchmark, giving stations with more telescopes more weight in that benchmark.
